Targets must be absolute EE VAs. Bind keeps a target only when it lies in [function.start, function.end) and is an instruction of that function. index is parsed and then ignored; the map stores entry.target only. Duplicate [[jump_tables.table]] addresses concatenate targets, then sort+unique. One address serves every JR whose LUI/ADDIU/ORI window computes that address. This run emitted 41 distinct addresses, none shared.

Generated FUN_001ddb80 switch at JR 0x1dddbc has cases 0x1DDDC4, 0x1DDDD0, 0x1DDE10, 0x1DDECC, 0x1DDF18, 0x1DE01C, 0x1DE044, 0x1DE070, 0x1DE098, 0x1DE0BC. Toml table 0x30dfe0 has those 11 slots; 0x1de098 is index 1 and index 10, so unique collapses to 10 cases.

A JR binds only if the recompiler itself computes the table address: closest LW/LWU into the JR reg within 20, closest ADDU (fn 0x21) writing that base within 10, closest LUI of addu.rs or addu.rt within 20, low from a later ADDIU/ORI with rs==rt==that LUI rt, then plus the LW simm. Config is consulted only at that address. A saved-reg base or a LUI of a different register does not bind. JR $ra is not an indirect site.
